title: Employee directory search
tagline: Search crashes without a query, matches too much, isn't in order, and fails on a big limit.
lookFor: A missing URL value is `undefined`. Calling `.toLowerCase()` on it crashes.
'Starts with' is not 'contains'. Match the rule exactly.
You can't subtract names. Use `localeCompare` to sort text.
A `const` can't be changed later. Doing so crashes, but only when that line runs.

hints: What is `req.query.q` when the URL has no `q`?
The rule says 'name starts with'. What does the code use?
bugs.cause: `includes` matches anywhere in the name, so 'an' also finds 'Karan'.
Subtracting two names gives NaN (not a number), so nothing gets sorted.

hints: Read the error in the Output tab. What is being changed?
bugs.cause: `limit` is a `const`, and the code tries to change it when it's over 20. That crashes.

bugs.symptom: Hidden test: ' an ' with spaces finds nothing
bugs.cause: ' an ' with spaces never matches the start of a name.
bugs.fix: Trim q when you read it.
